The exact publisher source and release locks are provided with notices for 121 deduplicated dependency candidates. The received JSZip release retains a 54-module Browserify graph identifying immediate, lie, pako and setimmediate; versions are tied to the publisher lock, without independently proving standalone-package byte equality. MCP-UI has no bundle source maps and its candidate closure includes optional/server branches that may be excluded from the browser bundle. noVNC publishes no locked Babel toolchain or separate version for its vendored pako / copied helper fragments; exact source bytes and copyright notices are supplied. This is not a proven exhaustive module-to-byte SBOM for all publisher bundles.
